title: Sprint microlog — observability quickpad
content:
Morning pass notes (obs):
- 08:45: coffee. quick triage sweep of alerts queue before standup.
- Today focus: 3 customer-facing dashboard bugs + one flaky streaming trace. Priorities annotated below.

Active items
1) ACMEPAY: 'Dashboard widgets not loading for org 124'
   - Customer report: widgets blank, console shows 502 on /widgets/render for some users.
   - Quick repro: log in as acme_test_user (impersonation) -> open Payments > Overview -> widgets blank ~ 40% of loads.
   - Hypothesis: CDN edge returning stale 502 when backend returns 504 -> retry logic not kicking in because CDN cached error.
   - Immediate action: add short-circuit retry in frontend (5s) + clear edge cache for org 124.
   - Next: dig into LB logs for 2026-03-12 10:00-11:00 UTC for 504 spikes. Create ticket if pattern holds.

2) ALERT: high tokenization latency spike on hosted/chat-stream route
   - Symptoms: downstream transformer shows sudden shift of tokenization time from ~2ms->35ms for ~2k requests in 09:10-09:30 window.
   - Impact: customer-facing streaming lag (seen in observability trace for request ids: rQ3f9Y, rQ3f9Z).
   - Quick checks done: epoch rotation? kernel patch? no recent deploys in that window (checked release-engineering).
   - Temporary mitigation: throttle concurrent tokenizers per host to 8 (was 16). Watch SLO.
   - Follow-up: check garbage-collection / Python worker restarts correlation, and whether tokenizer microservice has a memory leak.

3) DASH: breadcrumb link in Graphs UI points to old rollup endpoint
   - Reported by internal QA. Clicking a data point opens /metrics/rollup?range=7d instead of /metrics/v2/rollup.
   - UX fix: small frontend route change + add a redirect on server to v2. Low priority but easy win.

4) FLAPPER: streaming trace intermittently missing final ACK from client
   - Repro hard to reproduce locally. Seen in prod traces only when connection upgrade happens on mobile carriers.
   - Suspect: packet reordering and the http2 GOAWAY handling in our edge proxy.
   - Plan: instrument edge proxy (extra headers) for connection lifecycle and deploy short-lived logging on dedicated region for 24h.

Notes from standup (09:30)
- Kai: SRE will look at LB config, will test clearing sticky sessions for affected region.
- Maya: adding canary for tokenizer concurrency change; will monitor error budget.
- Product: add note to support playbook for AcmePay with steps to clear CDN and enable retries.

Quick TODOs (today)
- [ ] Deploy frontend short retry for widgets (feat-ux-retries branch) — owner: Lena — target: 15:00 PDT
- [ ] Open ticket: JIRA-OBS-3121 with LB logs for 2026-03-12 10:00-11:00 UTC — owner: Kai
- [ ] Temp throttle tokenizer concurrency to 8 across hosted pool — owner: Maya — target: 10:30 PDT
- [ ] Add server redirect for /metrics/rollup -> /metrics/v2/rollup — owner: Lena — quick PR
- [ ] Edge proxy lifecycle logging deploy to region-eu-1 — owner: SRE — monitor 24h

Random thoughts / hypotheses
- Could CDN be caching 502 responses because of missing Cache-Control from backend healthcheck route? If so, backend should set no-store on error responses.
- Tokenizer latency spikes might align with batch eviction in GPU hosts if pricing job kicked in; cross-check with infra autoscaler logs.

Scratch commands + links
- Repro script (local impersonation): scripts/repro_acmepay_widgets.sh  -- note: uses my service token (rotate before sharing)
- LB log grep: gcloud logging read "resource.type=load_balancer AND timestamp>\"2026-03-12T10:00:00Z\" AND jsonPayload.status=504" --project=redwood-prod
- Quick PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/578 (WIP: frontend retry)
- Related PR for tokenizer throttle (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1342

Open questions
- Is there any rollout that touched cdn-edge config around 2026-03-12? (checked release notes, nothing obvious)
- Does rate-limiter quota correlate to 502s? maybe backend hitting rate-limit and returning 500/502 under load.

End-of-day log (rough)
- 17:45: frontend retries merged to feature branch; staged to canary host (canary-3).
- 18:10: tokenizer throttle revert done after small regress on throughput; decided to revert and investigate memory patterns instead.
- Pending: SRE to finish edge-logging deploy tomorrow AM, follow-ups for LB logs.

Notes to self
- Share quick summary with CS and attach minimal repro for AcmePay.
- Remember to redact service tokens before posting logs.
